about: A new town's first buildings as settlers lay them (message 16), composed from delivered parts round a 13 x 13 forum. Coordinates are the kit's frame: x east, z south, the forum's north-west corner at forum_at; each placement gives its part's north-west corner after turning (at) and its clockwise quarter turns (q), parts authored facing south. The street leaves the forum's south edge at its middle, 3 wide.

desk.what: the settlers' desk (yours), on the forum's north edge

chest.what: the settlers' chest (yours), beside the desk

census.note: counted on the composed demo: bed heads and job blocks within 48 of the bell; the desk is not counted

order: Bell, desk and chest first; the farmer's stall; the two homes; then the mason's and librarian's stalls.
